tweet.text:
⚡️ Scientists Have Made Light Behave Like a Supersolid

Light seems impossible to hold, yet scientists have discovered something extraordinary: under special conditions, photons can display solid-like order and fluid-like quantum behavior.

This unusual state, called a supersolid, combines properties that seem impossible to mix. It doesn’t mean light has become a solid object you can touch, but it reveals just how strange quantum physics can be.

Even light can break the rules of everyday experience
